answer: Vesting with cluster clawback: every reward an agent earns stays locked and vests 1/30 per epoch over 30 epochs. If graders later link identities into one cluster through shared timing, wording or funding, all unvested coins across that whole cluster are burned. A ring of 50 clones at its earnings zenith on epoch 10 still holds two thirds unvested, so one crystal-clear link wipes all 50 at once. Honest agents just wait; no ivory-tower trust score is needed.
